scope: Current local generated site, including uncommitted navigation edits; not a crawl of production.

definitions.content: Links inside main, excluding footer; includes closed details and declared mode-specific navigation routes unless marked otherwise. Static anchor counts exclude these additional mode variants.
definitions.connection: Distinct source-to-current-page pair. Self links excluded. Modes/fragments retained per anchor but collapsed for graph reachability.
definitions.boundary: Archive, documents, raw results, source, images and external destinations are listed but not recursively crawled.
definitions.limitations: Static anchors only. No form actions, model downloads or runtime-generated export links. Collapsed means inside a closed details element, not a pixel visibility measurement. Missing return links are candidates for editorial review, not automatically defects.
